hypothesis: Request227 failed because it mixed continuation availability with absolute economic-value calibration. A separate continuation/executability head plus a classification target for whether ENTER now is the best remaining positive WATCH opportunity should produce a more usable recurrent entry controller.

architecture.availability_head: episode-level classifier from first actually observed WATCH state
architecture.availability_label: at least two evaluable multi-event entry states among first five observed WATCH states
architecture.timing_label: current multi-event value is positive and no later WATCH state in the five-state window has greater value
architecture.watch_semantics: first five actually observed executable states, not fixed clock minutes
architecture.economic_outcome: BASE return at third subsequently observed executable state

leakage_controls.entry_gate: calibration p75 among availability-admitted evaluable timing rows

forbidden: using raw predicted return > 0 as an action boundary
using June23-29 outcomes to choose thresholds
claiming promotion from the already-opened development block
